verdict.rationale:
WooCommerce exposes a full CRUD REST API, a CLI (WC-CLI) and a native MCP server, all of which give an AI agent programmatic access to store data and could be scripted to loop over many items, but the evidence never documents a dedicated bulk/batch endpoint or bulk-update tooling explicitly built for high-volume operations. Community evidence is silent on bulk-op reliability.

missing for 10: explicit documentation of a batch/bulk REST endpoint or CLI bulk-update command, evidence of bulk performance/rate-limit handling, and independent confirmation that AI tools can reliably perform large-scale bulk edits.
